cards.title: Complements and bases: quick review
cards.body: $1000 - x$: all digits from $9$, the last from $10$. Near $100$: cross-subtract for the front, multiply the distances for the back.

cards.title: Crosswise: quick review
cards.body: $(10a + b)(10c + d) = 100ac + 10(ad + bc) + bd$. When the tens match and the ones add to $10$: $a(a + 1)$, then $b(10 - b)$.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ questions, easiest first, no hints. Type each answer. You need all $8$ right to pass. If you miss one, you’ll see how to do it, and the next try gives you new numbers.
